**Type**: `UiPath.Core.Activities.SAP.ExpandALVTree`
**Category**: UI Automation
**Description**: Expand parent ALV tree to the selected node. After indicating the SAP node element from the SAP GUI window, the selected node path will be displayed in the activity.

- `Path` (In [required]): `InArgument<String>`
- `ContinueOnError` (In): `InArgument<Boolean>`
**Other members**:

- `Id` [property]: `String`
